  public interface Continuation<T>
    fun resume
    fun resumeWithException
  public interface SuspendTask<T>
    suspend fun run
  public interface SuspendRegistration<T>
    fun register
  public struct FunctionSuspendTask<T> : SuspendTask<T>
    field task: suspend () -> T
    public suspend fun run
  public struct FunctionSuspendRegistration<T> : SuspendRegistration<T>
    field registration: (Continuation<T>) -> Unit
    public fun register
    @Intrinsic("coroutine_start")
  public fun startCoroutine<T>(task: SuspendTask<T>, completion: Continuation<T>)
    @Intrinsic("coroutine_suspend")
  public suspend fun suspendCoroutine<T>(registration: SuspendRegistration<T>): T
  public fun startCoroutine<T>(task: suspend () -> T, completion: Continuation<T>)
    Call startCoroutine
      Call FunctionSuspendTask
        Var task
      Var completion
  public suspend fun suspendCoroutine<T>(registration: (Continuation<T>) -> Unit): T
    =
      Call suspendCoroutine
        Call FunctionSuspendRegistration
          Var registration

  public struct PinnedPtr<T : ref>
    field raw: ULong
  public struct GcHandle<T : ref>
    field raw: ULong
    @Unsafe
    @Intrinsic("gc_pin_raw")
  internal fun _pin<T : ref>(v: T): ULong
    @Unsafe
    @Intrinsic("gc_unpin_raw")
  internal fun _unpin<T : ref>(raw: ULong): T
    @Unsafe
    @Intrinsic("gc_get_handle_raw")
  internal fun _getGcHandle<T : ref>(v: T): ULong
    @Unsafe
    @Intrinsic("gc_release_handle_raw")
  internal fun _releaseGcHandle<T : ref>(raw: ULong): T
    @Unsafe
  public fun pin<T : ref>(v: T): PinnedPtr<T>
    =
      Call PinnedPtr<T>
        Call _pin
          Var v
    @Unsafe
  public fun unpin<T : ref>(p: PinnedPtr<T>): T
    =
      Call _unpin<T>
        FieldAccess raw
          Var p
    @Unsafe
  public fun getGcHandle<T : ref>(v: T): GcHandle<T>
    =
      Call GcHandle<T>
        Call _getGcHandle
          Var v
    @Unsafe
  public fun releaseGcHandle<T : ref>(h: GcHandle<T>): T
    =
      Call _releaseGcHandle<T>
        FieldAccess raw
          Var h
